title: AI agents that pay in Bitcoin
summary: Guest Diego showed an open lab that turns agent sessions into constellations, a free Agentic Academy and a "cyborg company" where AI agents work in a 3D office. Then an agent paid for live Bitcoin data over Lightning with L402, and a Nostr bot earned zaps.
share_text: AI agents that pay in Bitcoin: a cyborg company run by agents, an agent buying data over Lightning with L402, and a Nostr bot that earns zaps. Notes, video and 2 mini-games from the @CodeOrangeDevs workshop
tldr: Agents can now hold and spend money: on the call an agent bought five pieces of live Bitcoin data for 10 sats each over Lightning, using L402.
Diego's "cyborg company" puts AI agents at desks in a 3D office. They raise a hand when they need a human, and the human signs off with a passkey.
Show your work to win work: an open lab of experiments is Diego's portfolio, and one small-business rebuild became a case study for the next client.
L402 is still experimental. Homework: build something small that uses it and show it next month.

ideas: Also on the call: a community member showed a voice tutor she built to practise Mandarin, with ChatGPT for the logic, Gemini for the design and free model keys from OpenRouter. Ideas for next time: pay 21 sats over L402 to join a workshop, a paywalled Substack-style page on Nostr, and an L402 experiment inside Diego's cyborg company with Code Orange as a design partner.

quiz.q: What does a server answer when an agent asks for paid data with L402?
o: 402 Payment Required, with a Lightning invoice
quiz.w: The agent pays the invoice and comes back with proof of payment. No account, no card.

quiz.q: In the cyborg company, what happens when an agent wants to issue a refund?
o: It raises its hand and a human approves with a passkey
quiz.w: That is the human in the loop: a person stays accountable for the decision.

o: No, it is still experimental and up to builders to try
quiz.w: Nobody on the call knew a mainstream product using it. That is the opportunity.

quiz.q: How does Diego use his free open lab?
o: As a showcase: clients see it and ask for the same in their company
quiz.w: You have to give something away to get something back.
